description:
## Socket command-surface correctness & security

Source: `notes/c11-audit-merged-2026-06-09.md` P1.2, P1.3, P1.4, P1.5, P1.6. Validated against HEAD `b3dfc10bc` (line numbers drifted heavily — corrected below). Theme: everything reachable through the socket dispatcher — threading, I/O framing, browser security, conversation resume, mailbox delivery. **Sequencing:** shares `TerminalController.swift`/`CLI/c11.swift` with the Stability and Performance tickets; do not run those three in parallel worktrees.

### A. Socket threading & focus policy (P1.2)
- **Telemetry on main (PARTIAL):** `set_status`/`log`/`set_progress` (handlers `TerminalController.swift:2355/2388/2397`) still flow through `main.sync` (`:1903-1908`). The `report_*` family (`:1827-1834`) already has an off-main fast-path when a `--tab=/--panel=` selector is passed (shell integrations always do). **Fix:** migrate `set_status/log/set_progress` to the same off-main fast-path. (Audit's `:17196/17384` are stale.)
- **`socketCommandFocusAllowanceStack` process-global race (CONFIRMED):** `nonisolated(unsafe) static var [Bool]` (`:175`), read `.last` (`:403`) / `popLast()` (`:444`), pushed/popped per command in `withSocketCommandPolicy` (`:435-450`); with one detached thread per connection (`:1633`), concurrent commands read each other's allowance and can steal focus. **Fix:** key the allowance per-request (thread-local or pass-through), not a shared LIFO.
- **`settings.open` / debug commands activate the app (CONFIRMED):** `v2SettingsOpen` (`:10289-10309`, default `activate=true`) and `v2DebugType` (`NSApp.activate` `:14296`) are not in `focusIntentV2Methods` (`:248-263`), bypassing the focus policy. **Fix:** gate behind focus-allowance or add to the focus-intent list deliberately.
- **`handleClient` unsynchronized read (CONFIRMED):** main-actor method (`:1721`) launched on a detached thread (`:1633`) reads plain `accessMode` var (`:172`) at `:1726` off-main. **Fix:** read under `listenerStateLock` or snapshot in the accept loop.

### B. Socket/CLI I/O correctness (P1.3)
- **Multibyte UTF-8 dropped (CONFIRMED):** `String(bytes:) ?? ""` per 4096-byte chunk (`TerminalController.swift:1761`) before newline framing — a CJK/emoji sequence straddling two reads is silently dropped. **Fix:** accumulate raw bytes, frame on `\n`, then decode.
- **CLI `write()` no short-write/EINTR (CONFIRMED):** `CLI/c11.swift:966-971` checks only `sent < 0`. **Fix:** loop until all bytes sent, retry `EINTR`.
- **fd/thread leak (CONFIRMED):** no read timeout on accepted clients (`configureSocketTimeouts` applied only in `probeSocketCommand:1203`), one detached thread per connection, `clientHandlers` (`:170`) declared but never populated, `stop()` (`:1287-1310`) closes only the listener. **Fix:** `SO_RCVTIMEO` on accepted fds, track in `clientHandlers`, close them in `stop()`.
- **120ms idle-read tax (CONFIRMED):** every v2 CLI invocation re-arms `multilineResponseIdleTimeoutSeconds=0.12` after the first newline and blocks until `EAGAIN` (`CLI/c11.swift:935,976-1002`). **Fix:** frame on terminator / content-length so single-line responses return immediately.
- **`send` doesn't reject unknown flags (CONFIRMED):** `c11 send --text "hi"` types `--text hi` literally (`CLI/c11.swift:~2435-2451` joins remaining tokens). **Fix:** reject unrecognized `--flags` before assembling text.
- **`set-status`/`log` quoting (CONFIRMED bug, symptom corrected):** `forwardSidebarMetadataCommand` (`CLI/c11.swift:12202-12204`) quotes with `shellQuote` but the v1 tokenizer interprets `\n` inside any quote — the corruption is **backslash-escape sequences** (`a\nb` → `a<newline>b`), NOT apostrophes (those roundtrip fine). **Fix:** swap to `v1QuoteForTokenizer`.
- **Password injection (CONFIRMED newline-only):** `client.send("auth \(socketPassword)")` (`CLI/c11.swift:4290`) appends `\n`, so a newline injects a second wire command. Interior spaces survive (parser does `dropFirst(5)`, not tokenize). **Fix:** reject newline (and edge-whitespace) in passwords at the boundary.

### C. Browser surface security (P1.4)
- **`browser.eval` / `state.save` / `state.load` ungated in any mode (CONFIRMED):** `v2BrowserEval` (`:11621`) runs arbitrary caller JS; `v2BrowserStateSave/Load` (`:13987/14047`) read+write cookies+localStorage at a caller-supplied path. Grep finds zero automation-mode gating — any same-user socket caller can exfiltrate/inject session auth. **Fix:** gate session-sensitive browser commands behind an explicit automation opt-in + path allowlist.
- **`state.save` writes 0644 (CONFIRMED `:14029-14034`)** — auth material world-readable. **Fix:** 0600.
- **`state.load` restores before navigation (CONFIRMED `:14064-14104`)** — cookies/localStorage land in the *previous* origin (no `didFinish` wait). **Fix:** defer restore to the navigation's `didFinish`.
- **`addinitscript`/`addstyle` accumulate forever (CONFIRMED `:14117/14160`)** — no removal/dedupe, `forMainFrameOnly:false` fires in cross-origin subframes. **Fix:** dedupe + removal API + cap; re-scope to main frame.
- **Subframe navs bypass filters (CONFIRMED):** `BrowserPanel.swift:6155 & 6177` gate insecure-HTTP and external-URL handoff on `targetFrame?.isMainFrame != false`, so subframe loads skip both. **Fix:** apply the classification to subframe navigations too.
- **Dialog model mismatch (CONFIRMED):** the dialog shim is installed lazily, only from `v2BrowserDialogRespond` (`TerminalController.swift:13228`); the always-on document-start userscript (`BrowserPanel.swift:2480`) is the console hook, not dialogs. So a page `confirm()` before any dialog command hits a native NSAlert and blocks the agent until a human clicks; once shimmed, native dialogs are silently swallowed for humans. **Fix:** install the dialog shim eagerly at document-start and route native dialogs through the queue.
- **Per-surface browser dicts never pruned (CONFIRMED leak; race NOT demonstrable):** `v2BrowserElementRefs`/`InitScripts`/`InitStyles`/`DialogQueue`/`DownloadEvents` (`:311-316`) get no `removeValue` on surface close. (Every access funnels through `v2MainSync`/`@MainActor`, so the audit's data-race claim does not hold — leak only.) **Fix:** prune all six on surface close.
- **`BrowserSnapshotStore` retains full-res NSImages (CONFIRMED `:43`)** for hibernated-never-resumed surfaces for process lifetime. **Fix:** evict on close + cap. (Overlaps Performance ticket P2.3 — coordinate.)
- **Drop, do NOT chase:** `javascript:` scheme in the omnibar — WRONG. The omnibar (`resolveBrowserNavigableURL:4102`) returns only http/https/file and routes `javascript:` to search; the `:860-869` entry only governs external-handoff classification, not execution.

### D. Conversation store & resume correctness (P1.5)
- **ClaudeCode resume has no `cd` into `ref.cwd` (CONFIRMED `Strategies/ClaudeCode.swift:56-58`)** — sessions in worktrees/subdirs are non-resumable; `ref.cwd` is captured but unused in the resume command (the legacy `AgentRestartRegistry` path ironically does `cd`). **Fix:** prepend `cd <quoted ref.cwd> &&`.
- **`shouldReplace` demotes a confident ref (CONFIRMED `Store.swift:289-315`)** — keys purely on `capturedAt` with no `state` awareness, so a newer-mtime `.unknown` candidate replaces a confident `.alive/.suspended`. **Fix:** refuse to let `.unknown` displace a confident ref.
- **`state=ended` invariant enforced client-side only (CONFIRMED):** `v2ConversationPush` (`:9904-9920`) accepts `state` from any caller and maps `ended→.unknown`; the "is the app terminating?" guard lives only in the CLI hook (`CLI/c11.swift:15108-15124`). **Fix:** enforce the shutdown precondition server-side.
- **`CMUX_DISABLE_CONVERSATION_STORE` kill-switch (CONFIRMED):** falls back to `AgentRestartRegistry` whose codex row (`:171-174`) emits `codex resume --last` — the exact global-lookup bug the store fixes. **Fix:** resolve a specific session id in the fallback, or document the kill-switch as best-effort.
- **Dead disambiguation layer (CONFIRMED, worse than stated):** `ConversationStrategyInputs` is **never constructed** and `strategy.capture(inputs:)` is **never called** in production — the entire Codex multi-candidate / activity-floor / cwd-filter layer (`SurfaceActivity.swift`, `Scrapers/ClaudeCodeScraper.swift:45-59`) is inert; the store is fed only by direct CLI-hook pushes. **Decision required:** wire `capture(inputs:)` into the live path, or delete the inert primitives.
- **`restoreSessionSnapshot` replaces tabs without full teardown (CONFIRMED `TabManager.swift:5537-5610`)** — reassigns `tabs = newTabs` (`:5609`) dropping old workspaces' panels/remote/mailbox to ARC with no explicit teardown (leaks on mid-session restore). **Fix:** tear down discarded workspaces before reassigning.

### E. Mailbox correctness (P1.6) — all CONFIRMED
- **Dispatch `id` from filename, never validated vs envelope `id`** (`MailboxDispatcher.swift:227`) — drives dedup (`:229/243`), `_processing` move, quarantine names; `envelope.id` (`:249`) is parsed but never cross-checked. **Fix:** reject on filename≠envelope.id.
- **Dedup ring in-memory only + no `_processing/` recovery sweep** (`:51-52,98-103,229,243`) — restart re-dispatches (documented guarantee lost); the recovery sweep is an explicit `TODO(stage-3)`; envelopes stranded in `_processing/` at kill time are never swept back. **Fix:** persist dedup state + sweep `_processing/` → `_outbox/` on start.
- **`invokeHandlerSynchronously` timeout data race** (`:387-412`) — `var result` written by the unstructured Task (`:393`) and the timeout path (`:399`) unsynchronized. **Fix:** guard with a lock / capture inside the gate.
- **`validateSurfaceName` doesn't reject reserved names** (`MailboxLayout.swift:143-162`; reserved at `:33-37`) — a surface named `_outbox` aliases the shared outbox → re-dispatch loop after restart. **Fix:** reject names beginning with `_` (or an explicit reserved set).
- **JSON-array `mailbox.delivery` registers zero handlers** (`MailboxSurfaceResolver.swift:74-77` keeps only `as? String`) → mail copied, never delivered; duplicate-title fan-out with no warning despite the doc promising one; valid-title-but-unsafe-path recipients drop as `.eio`. **Fix:** coerce/validate the type, warn on dup titles, validate recipient names at resolve time.
- **Body XML-escaping doesn't neutralize ANSI/OSC** (`StdinMailboxHandler.swift:154-183`) — only `& < >` handled; raw ESC/OSC bytes inject into the recipient agent's PTY (title spoof, screen clear, OSC 52 clipboard). The `:30-32` comment calls the escaping a "security property" but it only blocks tag-forgery. **Fix:** strip/escape C0 control bytes (esp. ESC) before the PTY write.

### Acceptance
Telemetry commands no longer block main; focus allowance is per-request; multibyte `send` payloads round-trip; `c11 send --text` errors instead of typing the flag; `browser.eval`/`state.*` require an automation opt-in and write 0600; a pre-command page `confirm()` doesn't deadlock the agent; worktree-captured Claude/Codex sessions resume into the right cwd; a mailbox body containing ESC sequences cannot drive the recipient's terminal.

Both edit TerminalController.swift — sequence, do not parallel-worktree

title: Socket command-surface correctness & security (threading/focus, I/O framing, browser security, resume, mailbox)
